scanNote:
3-UNITNING BIRINCHI BETI (18-bet). Fon - KO'K osmon va pastda ko'chadagi olomon surati.

Yuqorida chapda oq harflar bilan 'UNIT 3'. Ostida katta OCH SARIQ harflar bilan 'Shop till you Drop!'

YETTITA SURAT, har birida oq yorliq va bo'sh nuqtali joy (A - G):
• A - zargarlik do'koni: qizil baxmalli vitrinalarda taqinchoqlar, oldida mijozlar
• B - oq xalatdagi erkak javonlar orasida turibdi, javonlarda ko'plab shishalar va qutilar (dorixona)
• C - antikvariat: gipsli byust, bronza haykalchalar, kiyik figurasi, masxaraboz qo'g'irchoq
• D - to'rli buyumlar: oq dasturxonlar, ko'ylak, salfetkalar
• E - shokolad do'koni: ustma-ust terilgan shokolad konfetlar, oq to'r ustida
• F - meva-sabzavot rastasi: banan, olma, uzum, piyoz
• G - ko'chadagi kitob rastalari, atrofda odamlar

CHAP USTUNDA och ko'k YARIM ShAFFOF ustun:
• To'q sariq 'Lead-in' sarlavhasi.
1) 'Choose words from the list to label the pictures.' Ikki ustunda 20 ta so'z (qiya harflarda): lace shop, confectioner's, bookstall, bookshop, butcher's, bakery, post office, newsagent's, greengrocer's, chemist's / travel agent's, supermarket, antique shop, boutique, jeweller's, department store, flower stall, florist's, hair & beauty salon, designer fashion house.
2) 'Where can you buy these things? What else can you buy in each place in Ex. 1?' Qiya harflarda 25 ta buyum ro'yxati. Ostida ko'k qiya namuna: 'You can buy apples at a greengrocer's.'
3) 'In pairs, use the phrases below and words from Ex. 2 to act out dialogues, as in the example.' Ikki ustunli jadval: 'requests' va 'answers'. Ostida ko'k qiya namuna dialog.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '18'.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to label the pictures.
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarni nomlash uchun ro'yxatdan so'z tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
DO'KON NOMLARI.

  ⚠ Ingliz tilida ko'p do'kon nomi
  EGALIK ShAKLIDA: 'a butcher'S',
  'a baker'S', 'a chemist'S'.

  ⚠ Bu - qisqartma: 'a butcher's SHOP'
  ('qassobning do'koni'). 'shop' so'zi
  tushirib qoldiriladi, apostrof qoladi.

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'at the doctor's'
  (shifokorda), 'at my aunt's'
  (xolamnikida).


RO'YXATDAGI 20 DO'KON:

  a lace shop        - to'r do'koni
  a confectioner's   - shirinlik do'koni
  a bookstall        - kitob rastasi
  a bookshop         - kitob do'koni
  a butcher's        - qassob do'koni
  a bakery           - novvoyxona
  a post office      - pochta
  a newsagent's      - gazeta do'koni
  a greengrocer's    - sabzavot do'koni
  a chemist's        - dorixona
  a travel agent's   - sayohat agentligi
  a supermarket      - supermarket
  an antique shop    - antikvariat
  a boutique         - butik (kiyim)
  a jeweller's       - zargarlik do'koni
  a department store - univermag
  a flower stall     - gul rastasi
  a florist's        - gul do'koni
  a hair & beauty salon - sartaroshxona
  a designer fashion house - moda uyi


⚠ 'A SHOP' va 'A STALL' FARQI:

  a shop  - BINO ichidagi do'kon
  a stall - ko'chadagi RASTA

  ⚠ Shuning uchun 'a bookshop' va
  'a bookstall' - IKKI BOShQA narsa.
  ⚠ 'a flower stall' - ko'chadagi gul
  rastasi; 'a florist's' - do'kon.


⚠ 'A CHEMIST'S' va 'A PHARMACY':

  Britaniyada 'a chemist's',
  AQShda 'a drugstore' yoki
  'a pharmacy'.


⚠ 'A GREENGROCER'S':

  'green' (yashil) + 'grocer' (oziq-ovqat
  sotuvchisi) = meva-sabzavot do'koni.
  ⚠ 'a grocer's' - umuman oziq-ovqat
  do'koni.


⚠ 'A CONFECTIONER'S':

  'confectionery' = shirinlik.
  ⚠ Shokolad, konfet, tort sotiladi.


⚠ 'A BAKERY' - ISTISNO:

  Bu YAGONA nom bo'lib, egalik shaklida
  emas. ⚠ Lekin "a baker's" ham to'g'ri
  va bir xil ma'noda ishlatiladi.

items.whyUz:
⚠ A suratida qizil baxmalli vitrinalarda
taqinchoqlar.

⚠ 'a jewel' (javohir) → 'a jeweller' (zargar)
→ "a jeweller's" (zargarlik do'koni).
⚠ AQShda 'a jeweler's' (bitta 'l').

⚠ B suratida oq xalatdagi erkak dori
javonlari orasida.

⚠ Britaniyada "a chemist's", AQShda
'a drugstore' yoki 'a pharmacy'.
items.hintUz: Oq xalatdagi erkak, javonlarda shishalar va qutilar

items.whyUz:
⚠ C suratida eski haykalchalar, byust,
qo'g'irchoqlar.

⚠ 'antique' /ænˈtiːk/ deb o'qiladi - fransuzcha
so'z. 'ancient' bilan adashtirmang: 'antique' =
eski va qimmatli buyum.
items.hintUz: Gipsli byust, bronza haykalchalar, eski qo'g'irchoqlar

items.whyUz:
⚠ D suratida oq to'rli dasturxon, ko'ylak,
salfetkalar.

⚠ 'lace' = to'r, ilma-ilma mato.
items.hintUz: Oq to'rli dasturxon, ko'ylak va salfetkalar

items.whyUz:
⚠ E suratida ustma-ust terilgan shokolad
konfetlar.

⚠ 'confectionery' = shirinlik mahsulotlari.

⚠ F suratida banan, olma, uzum, piyoz.

⚠ 'green' + 'grocer' = meva-sabzavot sotuvchisi.
items.hintUz: Banan, olma, uzum va piyoz rastasi

items.whyUz:
⚠ G suratida KO'ChADAGI kitob rastalari.

⚠ 'a stall' = rasta (ko'chada);
'a shop' = do'kon (bino ichida).
Shuning uchun 'bookSHOP' emas, 'bookSTALL'.

exercises.instructionEn: Where can you buy these things? What else can you buy in each place in Ex. 1?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu narsalarni qayerdan sotib olish mumkin? 1-mashqdagi har bir joyda yana nima sotib olish mumkin?
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'You can buy apples at a greengrocer's.'

  ⚠ Qolip: You can buy + NARSA + AT +
     a + DO'KON.

  ⚠ Do'kon oldidan 'AT' predlogi
  ('in' emas): 'AT a greengrocer's',
  'AT the post office'.


⚠ BA'ZI BUYUMLARNI IKKI JOYDAN
OLISh MUMKIN:

  a book → a bookshop yoki a bookstall
  a leather jacket → a boutique yoki
     a designer fashion house
  lilies → a florist's yoki a flower
     stall
  a bottle of perfume → a chemist's
     yoki a department store

  ⚠ Bunday hollarda ikkalasi ham
  to'g'ri javob.


⚠ 'A DEPARTMENT STORE' - HAMMASI:

  Univermagda deyarli hamma narsa bor:
  kiyim, mebel, texnika, atir.
  ⚠ 21-betdagi matn Harrods univermagi
  haqida.


⚠ IDISh-O'LChOV SO'ZLARI:

  a PAIR OF trousers - bir juft shim
  a PACKET OF painkillers - bir quti dori
  a BOTTLE OF perfume - bir shisha atir
  a BOUQUET OF roses - bir dasta atirgul
  a LOAF OF bread - bir bo'lak non

  ⚠ 'trousers' - HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA,
  shuning uchun 'a pair of' kerak.
  ⚠ 'bread' - SANALMAYDIGAN, shuning
  uchun 'a loaf of'.


⚠ MATERIAL SIFATLARI:

  leather - charm
  woollen - jundan
  gold    - oltin
  lace    - to'rdan

  ⚠ Ot material sifatida ishlatilganda
  artikl olmaydi: 'a LEATHER jacket'.

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobdagi NAMUNA: 'You can buy apples at
a greengrocer's.'

⚠ Yana: potatoes, onions, carrots, oranges.

⚠ 'a travel agent' = sayohat agenti.
⚠ Yana: a holiday, a hotel booking, a cruise.

⚠ IKKALASI ham to'g'ri.
⚠ 'a bookshop' - bino; 'a bookstall' - ko'chadagi
rasta (G surati).

pairs.left: a pair of trousers, a woollen skirt
pairs.right: a boutique or a department store
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'trousers' HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA - shuning uchun
'a PAIR OF trousers'.
⚠ 'woollen' - Britaniya imlosi (AQShda 'woolen').

pairs.leftUz: bir quti og'riq qoldiruvchi, soch lak
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'a painkiller' = 'pain' (og'riq) + 'kill'
(o'ldirmoq) - og'riq qoldiruvchi dori.
⚠ 'hairspray' - dorixonada ham, sartaroshxonada
ham sotiladi.

pairs.left: a diamond ring, a gold necklace
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'a diamond' = olmos; 'a necklace' = marjon,
bo'yinbog'.
⚠ Material oldida artikl yo'q: 'a GOLD necklace'.

pairs.right: a florist's or a flower stall

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'a praline' = yong'oqli shokolad konfet.
⚠ E suratidagi do'kon.

pairs.right: a chemist's or a department store
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'perfume' - SANALMAYDIGAN, shuning uchun
'a BOTTLE OF perfume'.
⚠ Urg'u: PERfume (ot) - perFUME (fe'l).

⚠ 'a chop' = suyakli go'sht bo'lagi.
⚠ 'lamb' - 'b' O'QILMAYDI (17-betdagi
27-mashq qoidasi).

pairs.left: a leather suitcase, a washing machine
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Univermagda deyarli hamma narsa bor.
⚠ 'a washing machine' - qo'shma ot, AJRATIB
yoziladi.

⚠ 'a stamp' = pochta markasi.
⚠ 'the post office' - odatda 'THE' bilan,
chunki shaharda ma'lum bitta joy.

pairs.right: a boutique or a designer fashion house
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'leather' = charm; 'a jacket' = kurtka,
pidjak.
⚠ 'a boutique' - fransuzcha, /buːˈtiːk/.

⚠ 'a newsagent' = gazeta-jurnal sotuvchisi.
⚠ Britaniyada u yerda gazeta, jurnal, konfet va
chipta sotiladi.

⚠ 'sugar' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot.
⚠ 'a kilo of sugar', 'a bag of sugar' deyiladi.

⚠ 'bread' - SANALMAYDIGAN, shuning uchun
'a LOAF OF bread'. Ko'pligi 'loaVES'.
⚠ "a baker's" ham to'g'ri.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, use the phrases below and words from Ex. 2 to act out dialogues, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda quyidagi iboralar va 2-mashqdagi so'zlar bilan dialoglarni ijro eting, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
XUShMUOMALA ILTIMOS VA JAVOB.

KITOBDAGI JADVAL:

  REQUESTS (iltimoslar):
     Can I have ... , please?
     Could I have ... , please?
     Have you got any ...?
     I'd like ... , please.

  ANSWERS (javoblar):
     Yes, of course.
     Here you are.
     I'm afraid we haven't got any left.


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Can I have some apples, please?
  SB: I'm afraid we haven't got any left.


⚠ 'CAN' va 'COULD' FARQI:

  Can I have ...?   - oddiy, samimiy
  Could I have ...? - XUShMUOMALAROQ

  ⚠ 'could' bu yerda O'TGAN ZAMON
  EMAS - u iltimosni YUMShATADI.

  ⚠ Yana muloyimroq: 'May I have ...?'


⚠ 'I'D LIKE' = 'I WOULD LIKE':

  = ... olsam deb edim.
  ⚠ 'I want' dan ancha MULOYIM.
  ⚠ Do'konda va restoranda 'I want'
  deyish QO'POL eshitiladi.


⚠ "I'M AFRAID ...":

  = afsuski, ...
  ⚠ So'zma-so'z 'qo'rqaman' EMAS!
  Bu - yomon xabarni yumshatuvchi
  ibora.


⚠ 'ANY' - SO'ROQ VA INKORDA:

  'Have you got ANY apples?' (so'roq)
  "We haven't got ANY left." (inkor)
  'I've got SOME apples.' (tasdiq)

  ⚠ 'some' - tasdiqda;
  'any' - so'roq va inkorda.
  ⚠ Bu 6-unitning grammatika mavzusi.


⚠ 'LEFT' = QOLGAN:

  "We haven't got any LEFT."
  = bizda qolmagan.
  ⚠ 'to leave' (qoldirmoq) fe'lining
  3-shakli.


⚠ 'HERE YOU ARE':

  = mana, oling.
  ⚠ 10-betdagi 27-mashqda ham bor edi.

items.question: Can I have some apples, please?
items.answer: I'm afraid we haven't got any left.
items.whyUz:
Kitobdagi NAMUNA.

⚠ "I'm afraid" = afsuski (yomon xabarni
yumshatadi).
⚠ 'left' = qolgan.

items.question: Could I have a loaf of bread, please?
items.answer: Yes, of course. Here you are.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'Could' - 'Can' dan XUShMUOMALAROQ.
⚠ 'a loaf of bread' - 'bread' sanalmaydigan.

items.question: Have you got any stamps?
items.answer: Yes, of course. Here you are.
items.whyUz:
⚠ SO'ROQDA 'any' ishlatiladi.
⚠ Britaniyada 'have you got', AQShda 'do you
have'.

items.question: I'd like a bouquet of roses, please.
items.answer: Yes, of course. Here you are.
items.whyUz:
⚠ "I'd like" = 'I would like' - 'I want' dan
ancha MULOYIM.
⚠ Keyin OT yoki 'to' + fe'l keladi.

items.question: Have you got any painkillers?
items.answer: I'm afraid we haven't got any left.

items.question: Can I have a magazine, please?
items.answer: Yes, of course. Here you are.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'please' - gap OXIRIDA, vergul bilan.
⚠ Iltimosda 'please' deyarli MAJBURIY.

patterns.exampleEn: You can buy apples at a greengrocer's.
patterns.exampleUz: Olmani meva-sabzavot do'konidan sotib olish mumkin.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Do'kon oldidan 'AT' predlogi ('in' emas).
⚠ Do'kon nomi EGALIK shaklida: "a greengrocer's".

patterns.exampleEn: Could I have a loaf of bread, please?
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'Could' - 'Can' dan XUShMUOMALAROQ.
⚠ 'please' gap oxirida, vergul bilan.

⚠ SO'ROQDA 'any'.
⚠ Britaniyada 'have you got', AQShda 'do you have'.

patterns.exampleEn: I'd like a bouquet of roses, please.
patterns.exampleUz: Bir dasta atirgul olsam deb edim.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ "I'd like" = 'I would like'.
⚠ 'I want' - do'konda QO'POL eshitiladi.

patterns.formula: I'm afraid we haven't got any left.
patterns.exampleEn: I'm afraid we haven't got any left.

Sanalmaydigan va ko'plik otlar bilan ShART.
